title: 启用 lulynx Latent 特征蒸馏

standard.summary: 利用 DiT 中间层特征做归一化可选的加权 MSE；这是 lulynx latent 特征蒸馏，不是 LPIPS。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Uses DiT intermediate-layer features for a weighted MSE with optional normalisation; this is lulynx latent feature distillation, not LPIPS.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 利用 DiT 中间层特征做可选归一化的加权 MSE，并可限制 sigma 窗口。它没有 LPIPS 的预训练视觉 backbone/感知距离语义，默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Uses DiT intermediate-layer features for a optionally-normalized weighted MSE, with an optional sigma window. It lacks LPIPS's pretrained visual backbone / perceptual-distance semantics. Off by default.
